about: The fisher's order (VILLAGE_PLAN 3.4, V10): from play session 4, three fruits brought to Mar at the bridge (the bushes at the guide's camp); he pays two coins (fisher.delivered, then fisher.pay in game/host-events.json). Asking in Spanish is the lesson's; since D-game-27 (issue #42, handOver) the learner hands the goods over in Spanish when the NPC asks for them, and «no sé» or two missed lines hand them over anyway.
